decisions.reason: As a reusable crate for agriculture, it builds on the firm's existing container expertise and is a strategic focus, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
Foldable large containers are a core extension of the firm's returnable transport packaging knowledge.
Stackable plastic crates are directly aligned with the firm's existing crate and container capabilities.
Rackable pallets are a standard product within the firm's pallet manufacturing expertise.
Spill-retention pallets add environmental safety features but remain close to the firm's pallet knowledge, and in-house R&D can assimilate the additional requirements.
Pallets with load retainers extend the pallet line with cargo securement, which is absorbable given the firm's engineering and packaging expertise.
